translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: An c’a’al u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Corinto c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: Ma ju’tam huichat nan u nits’binchal in xe’tsintal a Cristo, antsana’ tata’chic tiquin nits’binchi u xe’tsintal c’al a Cristo.
An uxumchic tam ti tamcunal c’al an ebchalabchic
Ebchalabchic, nan u tsu’tal alhua’ jahua’ a t’ajal cum ets’ey tin t’ilchal u t’ojlabil c’al an Ajatic ani ets’ey a aynanchal an cau ax nan tu huat’banchamal.
U lej le’ abal ca ejtiychic abal a Cristo jaja’its an lej Oc’lec c’al patal an inicchic, ani an tomquith inic pel i oc’lec c’al in tomquil. A Dios ja’its u Oc’lec c’al a Cristo.
Pel i tithetaltalab max paxq’uiq’uith in oc’ an inic tam u ol al an tamcunel ebchalab, ani jaye tam u caulome c’al i cau axi ca pithan c’al a Dios quin huat’banchi an tamcunel ebchalab.

An uxum ojni’ quin co’oy in oc’ paxq’uiq’uith tam u ol ani jaye tam u caulome ti al an tamcunel ebchalab. Pel i tithetaltalab max yab in cua’al in oc’ paxq’uiq’uith, cum ejtil max huatsinchatac in oc’ ejtil max pelac i inic.

Alhua’ max ca muts’inchat in xi’il max yab in le’ quim paxq’uiy in oc’ ti al an tamcunel ebchalab. Ani max pel i tithetaltalab ca muts’inchat in xi’il o ca huatsinchat in oc’ ejtil i inic, in tomnal an uxum quin co’oy in oc’ paxq’uiq’uith ti al an tamcunel ebchalab.

Yab in tomnal an inic paxq’uiq’uith in oc’ ti al an tamcunel ebchalab, cum in ey hue’ ejtil in ey a Dios ani cum hue’ abatnom ejtil a Dios pel i Abatnom. Cum a Dios Abatnom c’al an inic jats tu tejhua’mel abal lej c’athpich pulic in ey. Cum an inic abatnom c’al an uxum, jats tu tejhua’mel abal pulic in ey an inic.
A Dios in ts’ejca’ an oc’ox inic. An inic yab tal c’al an uxum, an uxum ojni’ jats tal c’al an inic.
Jant’ini’ tin ts’ejca’ a Dios an uxum, u abatnab jaja c’al an inic ani yab pel in ey ti abatnom c’al an inic.
Jaxtam in tomnal an uxum paxq’uiq’uith in oc’ abal quin tejhua’methanchi ma c’al i ángelchic abal u abatnab c’al an inic.
An inic ani an uxum u yejenchix jun c’al xi jun. Antsana’ huahua’ ax i belal a Cristo i tsu’chal in ey an inic ani in ey an uxum.
Chubax tal an oc’ox uxum c’al an inic axi ts’ejcathits, ani xohue’ ojni’ tal an inic c’al an uxum. C’al a Dios ja’its tu tal patal jitats ani jahuats hua’ats.
Tata’chic a ejtohualac ca ulu max in tomnal an uxum ca olon ti al an tamcunel ebchalab yab quin co’oy in oc’ paxq’uiq’uith.
A cuete’ tsalap ti uchal abal tithetal an inic max huat’ath nactha’ in xi’il.
An uxum iba, cum jats in tomnal nactha’ in xi’il ani jats tu tsu’tab ti alabel. Jats c’al ca paxq’uin in oc’.

Hualam hua’ats jita’ c’al tata’chic in le’ quin hueutsixna’ c’al axe’ xi cau. Expith tu uchalchic abal in ujnamits tim patal an tamcunel ebchalabchic an uxum quin co’oy paxq’uiq’uith in oc’ tam u ol ani jaye tam u caulome c’al i cau axi ca pithan c’al a Dios quin huat’banchi an tamcunel ebchalab.
Am belom axi yab in t’ajal alhua’ ti al an santa cena
Nan tu uchalchic abal junchiquil yab alhua’ jahua’ a t’ajalchic tam it tamcunal tit c’ac’nax c’al a Dios, ani jaxtam yab lejat ela’ tabat max a Dios ti tolminchits c’al a ejattal.
Uxnal abal it lehuáx tam quit tamcunchic, ani hualam chubax anits a t’ajalchic.
Tata’ ojni’chic hualam a tsalpayalchic abal in tomnal tit lehuáx abal ca tejhua’metha’ jahua’ tam cuenel ax in t’ajal más tequeth ani jahua’ iba.
Max antsana’ it lehuáx tam ta ca t’aja’ an santa cena tejhua’ abal yab lej chubax a c’ac’nalchic an Ajatic.

Expith it tamcunalq’ui ani it c’apulq’uichic. Ta junchictal a xijc’ath c’apal jahua’ a chi’thamal ca junax c’apat, ani jaxtam hua’ats jita’chic yab u jilchinal jant’o quin c’apu ani u c’a’il. Ma hua’ats jita’chic u uts’alq’ui.

Auxe’ max yab a cua’al a q’uima’chic jun ti quit c’aputsq’ui ani quit uts’latsq’ui. C’al a t’ajbil antsana’ tocat a othnanchalchic in q’uima’ a Dios ani a tithebethal an ebchalabchic axi ts’ejhuantal. Hualam a le’chic abal nan cu ulu abal lej alhua’its jahua’ a t’ajalchic. Ni abal jay yab u lejel cu ulu max alhua’ jahua’ antsana’ a t’ajalchic.
An santa cena

Tim pithamal i cau an Ajatic tin cuenta an santa cena ani jats ax tu huat’banchamalchic. Im bajumalits nixe’ xi acal tam a Judas ne’ets quim bina’ i Ajatic Jesús ca tsemtha. An Ajatic im pena’ am pan.

Im bina’ i c’ac’namal yan c’al a Dios ani tiq’uele in mu’u am pan. Im pithanchi in exobalilchic ani in ucha’: Ca c’apu axe’ xi pan cum pel u inictal axi ne’ets cu bina’ quin yajchiquiyat tin calchix c’al tata’chic. Tiquin t’ila’ tam antsana’ ca c’apuchic axe’ xi pan.

In c’apuchic am pan ani tiq’uele a Jesús im pena’ an uts’umtalab c’al an vino. Im bina’ i c’ac’namal yan c’al a Dios. Im pithanchi in exobalilchic ani in ucha’: Pel u xits’al axi ne’ets cu huac’la’ al an cruz. Tin ebal u xits’al a Dios ne’ets quin ts’ejca’ i it jilchith cau c’al an inicchic. Tiquin t’ila’ antsana’ tam ca uts’a’chic axe’ xi vino, in ulu an Ajatic.

Jay i calel tata’chic ca c’apu axe’ xi pan ani ca uts’a’ axe’ xi vino a tejhua’methanchal c’al a at inicchic abal tsemets an Ajatic ti calchix al an cruz. Antsana’ ca t’aja’chic ma ta ca chich junil an Ajatic.
Ca t’ajan an santa cena c’al i tequethtalab

In t’ajal i hualabtalab jitats quin c’apu am pan ani quin uts’a’ an vino ti al an santa cena max yab c’al i lej tequethtalab tin ichich. Jolbithits tin tamet a Dios, cum ejtil max in tilibnanchal in inictal ani in huac’lath xits’al an Ajatic.
Yab ca c’apuchic am pan ani yab ca uts’a’ an vino ti al an santa cena max yab oc’ox ca lej alhua’ tsalpay ta ichich max it lej chubax c’ac’nax c’al a Dios.

Ne’ets ca jolbiyat c’al a Dios jitats quin alq’uith c’apuq’ui ani quin alq’uith uts’a’q’ui. Yab in lej alhua’ penamalits tin ichich max nixe’ xi pan pel i t’ipchixtalab c’al in inictal an Ajatic axi yajchiquinchat ti al an cruz.
Jaxtam hua’ats c’al tata’chic yan ax u ya’ul ani yan ax u palulul in inictal, ma talchic tsemetsits.
Yab ne’ets tucu jolbiy an Ajatic max u lej chubax c’ac’nax c’al jaja’.
Max tucu jolbiy ani tucu yajchiquiy, jats expith abal yab cu jum putat jolbiyat jant’ini’ ne’ets ca jum putat jolbiyat axi yab exlomchic c’al a Dios.
Taley ebchalabchic, tam quit tamcun ca t’aja’ an santa cena quit aychixin tam ne’ets tit c’apul, ani yab ca luba’ ca xijc’ath c’apu cuetem.

Jitats u lej c’a’il ca oc’ox c’aputs tin q’uima’ abal i ca jolbiyat c’al a Dios max ca xijc’ath c’aputs tam ti tamcuth c’al an ebchalabchic. Hua’atse i cau axi ne’ets cu ts’ejca’ talbel tam quin ulits c’al tata’chic.
